(1130 minutes) |discs= |cassettes= |pages= |isbn=9780593910085 |timeline=[[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]'' |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Survivor's Quest''''' is the unabridged audio version of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Survivor's Quest|novel of the same name]] by author [[Timothy Zahn]]. The audiobook is performed by [[Marc Thompson]] and was released by [[Random House Audio]] on [[December 19]], [[2023]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''. An unabridged (109 minutes) recording of the the short story "[[Fool's Bargain]]", also written by Zahn, follows the novel.
